note: Called it = later put on the public record. Still open = contested or unresolved. No verdicts from us — follow the record links.

called_it.title: Gulf of Tonkin second attack sold to Congress
called_it.blurb: Critics said the Aug 4, 1964 attack was exaggerated or fabricated as a pretext. NSA historian Hanyok later concluded SIGINT did not support the second attack as presented.

called_it.title: CIA mind-control / drug experiments on people
called_it.blurb: Long dismissed as paranoia. Church Committee and Senate MKUltra hearings put behavioral-modification programs — including unwitting dosing — on the record.

called_it.title: FBI covertly disrupting domestic political groups
called_it.blurb: Activists claimed the Bureau was sabotaging movements. COINTELPRO files and Church Committee reports confirmed covert disruption tactics.

called_it.title: Pentagon planners drafted fake-attack pretexts
called_it.blurb: Sounds like movie lore. The 1962 Joint Chiefs Northwoods memo proposed staged incidents to justify invading Cuba. Not approved — but the paper is real.
called_it.when_called: Skeptics of 'governments don't plan false flags'
called_it.when_record: Declassified JCS memo in NARA / NSA Archive

called_it.title: U.S. Public Health Service withheld syphilis treatment
called_it.blurb: Medical-abuse warnings sounded extreme until the Tuskegee study record showed decades without informed consent or proper treatment.

called_it.title: NSA mass digital collection on Americans' traffic
called_it.blurb: Surveillance warnings called tin-foil — until Snowden disclosures and court/FOIA fights put PRISM and related programs into public view.

called_it.title: CIA wiretapped journalists (Project MOCKINGBIRD)
called_it.blurb: Broader 'Mockingbird controls all media' lore is still argued. Narrower record: Family Jewels describe a 1963 telephone intercept on two Washington newsmen under Project MOCKINGBIRD.

called_it.title: U.S. recruited Nazi-affiliated scientists after WWII
called_it.blurb: Dismissed as Soviet propaganda by some at the time. National Archives and later histories document Operation Paperclip transfers.

still_open.title: Who exactly was behind JFK's assassination beyond Oswald?
still_open.blurb: Lone gunman vs conspiracy still splits researchers. Millions of pages released; no single file ends the fight. HSCA said probable conspiracy; acoustics later contested.

still_open.title: Do crash-retrieval / non-human craft programs exist?
still_open.blurb: Whistleblowers sworn under oath say yes. AARO historical review says it found no extraterrestrial tech in reviewed holdings. Hearings continue; evidence standard is the whole game.

still_open.title: COVID-19 origin: lab, market, or still unknowable?
still_open.blurb: Intel agencies split or undecided in public summaries. Scientific papers conflict. FOIA and hearings keep adding fragments — no public consensus slam-dunk.

still_open.title: Full scope of Epstein's client / trafficker network
still_open.blurb: Unsealed civil docs and flight materials name many people. Naming ≠ conviction. Criminal case ended with his death; Maxwell convicted. Huge unanswered graph remains.

still_open.title: WTC 7 collapse — fire vs controlled demolition debate
still_open.blurb: NIST attributes WTC 7 to fire-induced failure. Architects & Engineers for 9/11 Truth and others dispute. Primary engineering reports vs critic analyses — dig both.

still_open.title: Who really 'owns' and directs the Federal Reserve?
still_open.blurb: Structure is public/private hybrid created by Congress. Believer lore adds dynastic bank control narratives. Read the Act, FOMC transcripts, and critic books side by side.

still_open.title: Scale of 2020 election irregularities (if any)
still_open.blurb: Officials and CISA called it secure; believers cite machine vendors, ballot rules, and affidavits. Courts largely declined to overturn. Dockets and audit reports > viral clips.

still_open.title: Apollo landings faked in studio?
still_open.blurb: Believer documentaries argue lighting, radiation, and film anomalies. NASA, LRO imagery, and retroreflectors are the mainstream record. Still a live culture war — compare primary mission data with Rumble/YouTube essays.
